description: This file contains utility functions for creating, transforming, and comparing 2D points, including conversions, rotations, translations, and distance calculations, used within a graphics or drawing application.

methods.name: pointFrom
methods.description: Creates a typed Point instance from x and y coordinates.

methods.name: pointFromArray
methods.description: Converts an array of two numbers into a Point, or returns undefined if invalid.

methods.name: pointFromPair
methods.description: Converts a tuple of two numbers into a Point.

methods.name: pointFromVector
methods.description: Converts a vector to a point, optionally offset by a given point.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Checks if a value has the shape of a Point.

methods.name: pointsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two points are approximately equal within a tolerance.

methods.name: pointRotateRads
methods.description: Rotates a point around a center by a given angle in radians.

methods.name: pointRotateDegs
methods.description: Rotates a point around a center by a given angle in degrees.

methods.name: pointTranslate
methods.description: Translates a point by a vector.

methods.name: pointCenter
methods.description: Finds the midpoint between two points.

methods.name: pointDistance
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: pointDistanceSq
methods.description: Calculates the squared distance between two points.

methods.name: pointScaleFromOrigin
methods.description: Scales a point from a given origin by a multiplier.

methods.name: isPointWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks if a point q lies within the bounding rectangle defined by points p and r.
